suite: Android app code (Flutter web preview, PAYMENT_MODE=api) on the real local backend, DEVELOPMENT payment provider
note: The same Dart code as the APK, run in the browser preview. Razorpay's Android screen cannot run in a browser (the plugin has no web build) and no Razorpay credentials exist on this machine: the provider's own screen is NOT exercised here. The real device is verified by the owner (USER DEVICE VERIFICATION = PENDING).

results.name: A0 the app signs in against the local backend (same Dart code as the APK, PAYMENT_MODE=api)
B1 THE CONFIRMED CHECKOUT SAYS PAYMENTS CAN BE TAKEN: provider READY (the development provider, FAKE) — and the payment screen is the BACKEND'S: "Ready to pay"
B2 THE SCREEN shows the backend's total with its currency (₹427.00 · INR), puts it on the button — and has no field for a card, a CVV or a UPI PIN (no input at all)

B3 PAY ASKS THE BACKEND FOR A PAYMENT ATTEMPT: the request names the price the customer saw (its fingerprint) and a method TYPE — no amount, no currency, no status — with the customer session and an idempotency key
B4 THREE QUICK TAPS, ONE PAYMENT: exactly one start request left the phone and the checkout has one attempt

B5 THE ATTEMPT IS THE BACKEND'S: PROVIDER_READY for exactly the checkout's total in INR; the checkout is PAYMENT_PENDING; on this machine the development provider's sheet stands in for the provider's own screen ("no money moves")
B6 THE PROVIDER'S OUTCOME IS REPORTED, NOT BELIEVED: the app sends outcome "success" with the provider's payment reference and proof — no amount, no status — and the BACKEND answers VERIFIED

B7 PAID IS NOT ORDERED: the screen says "Payment verified" and "order creation is pending", shows no order confirmation and no order number, and offers nothing to pay again; in the database the attempt is VERIFIED with its order state ORDER_PENDING
B8 the phone keeps no proof of payment: neither the provider's proof nor its payment reference is in the app's storage
C1 APP KILLED AFTER PAYING, STARTED AGAIN: the app asks the BACKEND what the payment is (GET /payments/{id}) and shows VERIFIED — it posts nothing and opens no provider

C2 A PHONE THAT KEPT NOTHING FINDS THE PAYMENT AGAIN: checkout is refused by the backend (409 payment_in_progress, naming the checkout), the screen offers "Go to payment", and the payment screen reads that checkout and shows the VERIFIED payment — nothing is started
D1 CANCEL: the app reports "cancelled" (nothing else), the backend answers CANCELLED in its own safe words; the checkout is READY again with nothing charged, and the screen offers to try again

D2 RETRY IS A NEW ATTEMPT, AND A FAILURE IS SHOWN IN THE BACKEND'S SAFE WORDS: attempt 2 with another id; the provider says failed, the backend answers FAILED with a category; the screen shows the backend's message and no provider error code
D3 PENDING: the bank has not answered — the screen waits, warns "do not pay again", offers "check payment status" and no Pay or retry button
D4 NO CONNECTION WHILE THE PAYMENT IS PENDING: the screen says the payment status needs confirmation and not to pay again — it does not say the payment failed and offers no retry

results.name: D5 BACK IN FRONT WITH A CONNECTION: the app asks the backend at once and shows PENDING again — still nothing is paid twice (one open attempt)
D6 THE PROVIDER'S EVENT SETTLES IT: the bank confirms later, the provider sends a signed event, the backend verifies — the app, asking the backend, shows VERIFIED; the phone never reported a success
E1 THE RESTAURANT PAUSES ORDERS BEFORE THE CUSTOMER PAYS: Pay is refused by the backend (409 checkout_stale) — no attempt, nothing charged — and the screen sends the customer back to review the order
